translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

book.name: 1 Tesalonicenses
book.title: Tesalónicagi Gwenadgan-Bukmaladse Pablo Gebe Garda Narmaksad 1 Tesalonicenses

content: Ar anmar bela-bela nue be-dakbigusmarsoggu, Atenasgi walagwen an beoye an binsaarsunnad.

A-ulale anmar-gwenad-Timoteo bemarse an barmismalad, be-daknamalagar. We-Timoteo Bab-Dummadga-arbadimogad-duled, degine, anmarba Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-nued Cristogi-sunmaklegedgi sunmakdimogad-dulebalid. Timoteo an bemarse barmismalad, adi bemar-Cristogi-bensulidba gwagegi bemar-ogannomalagar, degine, nabir-ito-bemar-imakmalagarbar.
Adi bemar solegagwar guarmalar, mer bemar wargwensaar galakumalagar. Ar bemar-sunnad nue wismalad, ar weyob anmar wilemalar-gebed.
Deginbali, anmar bemar-abargi gudigua, bato an bemarga sogsamalad, anmar nue wilemaloye. Ar bemar nue wismalad, anmar bemarga igi sogsamala, deyob anmar bela wilesmalad.

A-ulale, ani Pablo, nue be-dakbigusmarsoggu, bemarse egisegala, an Timoteo-barmisad, adi an wisguegar, igi bemar-Jesúsgi-bensurmalad gudimar-dibeye, abakalegi nia-saila bemar-binsaed gasale, degiir, binsa an arbas-itole.

Timoteo Tesalónicase-gudiid gannar anmarse nonigu, anmarga gaya-nued senonikid, anmarga sognonikid, bemar Bab-Jesúsgi nue bensurmarye, degine, gwenadgan-nue-sabmarbarye. Anmarga sognonibalid, bemarde nue-sabedgine anmargi binsadiiye, degine, nue anmar-dakbi-gudiiye, igi anmar bemar-dakbigudimogadyob.
A-ulale gwenadgan, anmar wileged-abargi, degi, nue naibi-itoged-abargi, anmar yeer itonaded, anmar itoarmargu, bemar Bab-Jesúsgi nue bensuli-gudimarye.
A-ulale bemar nue anmar-ogannosmarmogad, bemar gandikidba Bab-Jesúsgi akanaid-ular.
Degisoggu, unniguarsulid Bab Dummadga anmar sogmalad bemar-nuggi, dog-nuedye, ar bemar nue-weligwar Bab-Dummad-asabin anmar-imaked.
Ise-egisar, mutikidba, degine, ibginedba, anmar Bab Dummadse gornaid, bitigi bemar-daked anmarga imaksana-gadinye, adi bemar Cristogi bensulid wis galakunaidgi bemar-bendakegar.
Bitigi Bab-Dummad-sunnad anmar-Baba, degine, anmar-Dummad-Jesucristo, anmarga igar-egaena-gadin, adi anmar bemar-daknamalagar.
Bitigi Bab-Jesús gatik muchub-muchub sabguedgi bemar-ogannomai, degine, gatik bemar-onasgumai imakena-gadin. Degine, bela bemar dulemar-sabguena-gadin, igi anmar bemar-sabmarmogadyob.
Adi Bab Dummad anmar-Baba, a-asabin bemar gwage-swilidik, gutu-naisuli, degi-sadegu guegar, anmar-Bab-Jesucristo bela egi-akananaimalad-abargi danikoed ibase.
